assessment: Ryan et al., compare the effects of acute FH or SDH inhibition with genetic ablation of FH or SDH in kidney epithelial cells. The consider how each intervention affects metabolite levels, alters the fate of labeled nutrients, and how it influences the transcriptome and proteome. This includes showing that disrupting the TCA cycle has a large effect on amino acid metabolism, and activates a stress response to maintain redox and amino acid homeostasis.
